scientific_question: Does GIADA's paired one-step soma RMSE advantage over the 8,002-parameter Branch-ELM core survive increasing authentic teacher time?

historical_small_support_result.scope: train-derived disjoint development support; one-step only

advance_policy: Advance one stage only after integrity validation and paired evaluation of the preceding stage.

data_method.teacher: canonical Hay L5PC NEURON model at commit 074c4666300a8ad246601dab179a97a6942f0f29
data_method.input_distribution: published NeuronIO NMDA ranges, temporal smoothing, morphology-length weighting and exponential-then-Bernoulli event sampling
data_method.release_input: causal U_realized from authentic probabilistic synapses
data_method.rich_event_dataset_role: separate held-out/event-enriched sidecar, not duplicated at paper scale

operational_cpu_decision.pod: RunPod 5 GHz compute-optimized, 8 vCPU, 16 GiB RAM
operational_cpu_decision.selection_basis: highest measured aggregate steady-state throughput on the fixed-price pod

support_amendment.reason: The original integrity validation omitted a per-split dynamical-support gate. S1 validation contained no |delta V| >= 1 mV transition and no somatic spike.
support_amendment.s1_immutability: S1 data, seeds, split and completed result remain frozen; no post-hoc replacement is allowed.
support_amendment.pilot_role: development-only input-support diagnosis, never a final held-out test
methodological_invariants: all conditioned rates remain inside the original NeuronIO support
canonical teacher, morphology, synaptic locations and weights remain unchanged
one discovery and one independent confirmation trajectory per factorial cell
a fresh event-support corpus will be preregistered only after the pilot
